title: fix(runtime,hono): close the remaining raw-driver-message exits on the HTTP boundary (#3867 follow-up)
body:
Follow-up to #3867 / #3875. That PR sanitised one dispatcher error exit; the sweep it called for found the other one, still open.

## What #3875 missed

`errorResponseBase` covers errors **thrown** out of `dispatch()`. It does not cover the ones `dispatch()` **returns** — a `{handled: true, response}` result goes to `sendResult` and never reaches that catch. Those bodies are built by `HttpDispatcher.error()`, which passed the message through verbatim.

Not theoretical. `PUT /meta/:type/:name` with a throwing `protocol.saveMetaItem`, before this change:

```
insert into `sys_team` (`id`) values (?) - UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_team.id
```

A physical table and column name, returned to the client. Reachable the same way through `/packages` install (`errorFromThrown(e, 500)`) and the MCP transport's `deps.error(err?.message, 500)`.

## Two exits closed

| Exit | Why it can carry a driver dump |
|:---|:---|
| `HttpDispatcher.error()` | the single construction point for every **returned** error response — `errorFromThrown` (`/meta`, `/packages`) and MCP all funnel through it |
| `@objectstack/hono` auth-config 500 | built from a caught error with `message: err.message`; the auth service reads from the database |

Both use the `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` predicate #3867 put in `@objectstack/types`, so all three boundaries now share one rule.

## Scoped to 5xx, and `details` untouched

A 4xx message is a deliberate answer — `Path must be /actions/:object/:action`, a hook's own `throw`, a `saveMetaItem` field error — and must reach the caller intact. Swallowing those would be a worse bug than the leak, so the guard only fires on 5xx (pinned by two of the four new cases).

Structured `details` is never touched: it carries the semantic `code` and per-field `issues` the Studio maps back to inputs, never free-form driver prose. A sanitised 500 still carries everything a client can act on.

Diagnostics are unaffected — callers that threw still hand the original error to `errorReporter` via `__obsRecordedError`, and every 5xx is logged server-side.

## Audited and deliberately left alone

- Inline error bodies in the `ai` / `mcp` domains — static literal strings, no interpolated error text.
- `plugin-hono-server`'s three 403s — 4xx with deliberate messages.

With this change every **dynamic** message on both dispatcher exits and the REST data routes goes through one predicate.

## Tests

`http-dispatcher.error-leak.test.ts` (4) — **2 red without the guard**. Drives `dispatch()` on a real route rather than calling the private method: SQL dump on a returned 5xx is replaced; a 4xx that resembles SQL is not; an ordinary 5xx message is not; `details` survives sanitisation.

`pnpm test` green across the monorepo (132/132 turbo tasks).
